chunks: "Any camel on which hajj is performed for three years will be made among the livestock of Paradise."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the speaker of the hadith
key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: Paradise, the abode of divine reward
key_terms.بَعِيرٍ: a camel used as a riding animal
key_terms.حُجَّ: hajj was performed upon it or by means of it
key_terms.رُوِيَ: it is narrated or reported in another version
key_terms.سِنِينَ: years; the repeated number of years mentioned in the report

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for a camel used repeatedly for hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith states that a camel repeatedly used for hajj is honored with a reward connected to Paradise. It reflects the spiritual nobility of means employed in acts of worship and encourages merciful regard for animals used in obedience to Allah.
